course_summary: This course teaches full-stack web fundamentals: HTML/CSS/JavaScript, Git, building REST APIs with Node.js and Express, basic SQL with PostgreSQL, authentication, and deployment.
readiness_explanation: The syllabus directly covers REST API construction, SQL basics, and authentication, which are core backend skills. It scores in the middle range because it does not cover testing, caching, or system design, which most backend roles also expect.

matched_skills.syllabus_evidence: Week 9-10: Building RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express, including routing, middleware, and JSON request/response handling
matched_skills.career_relevance: Backend developers spend most of their time designing and maintaining REST APIs.

matched_skills.syllabus_evidence: Week 11: Introduction to relational databases and SQL - basic CRUD operations using PostgreSQL
matched_skills.career_relevance: Nearly every backend service reads from and writes to a relational database.

matched_skills.syllabus_evidence: Week 12: Authentication basics - sessions, cookies, and JSON Web Tokens
matched_skills.career_relevance: Backend developers are commonly responsible for securing endpoints and managing user sessions.

skill_gaps.importance: Backend teams expect unit and integration tests before code ships to production.
skill_gaps.next_step: Learn a testing framework (e.g. Jest for Node.js) and write tests for one existing API route.

skill_gaps.importance: Teams rely on clear API contracts (e.g. OpenAPI/Swagger) to integrate frontend and backend work.
skill_gaps.next_step: Add OpenAPI/Swagger docs to the syllabus's final CRUD project.

project_recommendations.title: Tested Task-Tracker API
project_recommendations.outcome: A small REST API (tasks/users) with full CRUD, JWT authentication, and an automated test suite.
project_recommendations.success_criteria: All endpoints are covered by passing automated tests, and the repo README documents each route.

project_recommendations.title: Documented Public API
project_recommendations.outcome: The same API extended with OpenAPI/Swagger documentation and a hosted interactive docs page.
project_recommendations.success_criteria: A visitor can read the Swagger UI and successfully call every endpoint without reading the source code.

tasks: Write tests for 3 existing routes from the final project
Write a project README with setup instructions

assumptions: Assumed the student already has the Node.js/Express project from Week 9-14 available to extend, since the syllabus does not specify project retention.
warnings: Syllabus does not mention a specific testing framework, so the recommendation defaults to Jest, a common choice for Node.js.
